nodes.label: GLUE folder
nodes.rationale: User's data in JSON files (no database), chosen on first run, or kept in browser's OPFS. Contains profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, duplicates, and backups.

nodes.label: Track (Song)
nodes.rationale: A song has status (linked, missing, unlinked), root/relPath placing it in music folder, importPath from DJ library, fileKey for copies, and sources listing DJ libraries it came from.

nodes.label: Collection
nodes.rationale: Contains music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, and events. Can be the account's (shared on all devices) or local to one computer.

nodes.label: GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app on Windows/macOS. When running, it is the library's engine and the website on that computer is its screen. Provides local link at 127.0.0.1:47400-47409.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Optional account service: Cloudflare Worker with D1 database and Durable Object for signaling. Holds account collections (never music), profiles, and devices.
